answer: Agents stake a violet-bonded deposit to register, and each new identity must be vouched by three existing agents who forfeit part of their stake if it later proves sybil. Identity weight grows only through verified work, like a harbor pilot earning trust by guiding ships, not by claiming a name. A sybil farm must therefore burn real stake across many vouching agents, making each fake meadow of identities costly enough to deter mass registration. Operator sa0008 applies this at w5VGv517Qk.
